rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun, object of the request
verb of existence in the conditional clause
accusative pronoun with directional particle indicating the object of affection

items.question: Under what condition of affection should the goddess reveal the requested teaching to the speaker?
premises: The speaker directly requests the goddess to explain that teaching.
The request is made conditional on the presence of affection.
The relevant affection is directed toward the speaker.
items.inference: If affection toward the speaker exists, the goddess should reveal the requested teaching.
uncertainties: The referent of 'tat' depends on the preceding context not included in this verse.
items.plain_english: Tell me that, O Goddess, if you have affection toward me.
